source.quote: The number of shares outstanding of the registrant's common stock as of September 29, 2026, was 443,129,349 .

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as COST; no preferred shares are issued. The FY2026 10-K cover (September 29, 2026) is newer than the latest 10-Q (quarter ended May 10, 2026), so it is used.
